decisions.reason: As a core upholstery fabric with strong website visibility, it fits the firm's existing textile knowledge closely and is likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.
It is closely related to the decorative fabric range, so the firm can learn from early market feedback, but its lighter website presence suggests somewhat higher pruning risk than the lead launches.
This functional curtain fabric matches the firm's established contract and performance capabilities well, and its dedicated presentation signals a product the firm is likely to refine and retain.
The product builds on existing decorative textile know-how, yet as a wool-blend item with less visible market emphasis it faces a moderate chance of being rationalised if demand is only modest.
The firm has the absorptive capacity to develop this technically related fabric further, but its niche positioning and lower prominence make it the most vulnerable of the current launches.
